audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating and carryRating were empty strings while breakdown.difficulty and report[14] both state 6/10 and 6/10.
audit.why: Blank rating fields render an empty badge and contradict the prose already on the page. Enum fields, exempt from the length band. 50.81% over 2236 games supports the stated EVEN.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart was wrong on four of seven rows, and its own why-text said so. whys[0] and whys[2] say 'Dr. Mundo-favoured' above side tokens reading 'Wukong' and 'Skill'; whys[3] and whys[4] say 'Wukong-favoured' above tokens reading 'Skill' and 'Dr. Mundo'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Dr. Mundo, Wukong, Dr. Mundo, Wukong, Wukong, Dr. Mundo, Dr. Mundo] with no defects flagged for this matchup, and it agrees with the whys[] text on every single disputed row. The side tokens are the outlier. This is a genuine seesaw lane — Mundo edges 1 and 3, Wukong owns 2, 4-5 and 6 — not the flat 'his early, my late' shape the tokens carried.
audit.corrected: All four flips proposed as one atomic group across both layers, plus the three phases[].why lines that directly contradicted their new side, plus the window lists in breakdown.spikes and report[2].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page told the player what the visual tell for Wukong's burst actually is.
audit.why: Crushing Blow (Q) is an auto-attack reset, so his combo opens on an attack wind-up rather than a spell cast. A player watching for a cast animation steps back a full swing too late. This is the one interaction the _missing file flags for this matchup.
audit.corrected: report[5].t rewritten around the auto-reset tell.

edits.before: Your worst level in the game — base stats lose every straight trade. Throw Infected Bonesaw from max range, last-hit, and conserve the health pool Wukong wants to chip.
edits.after: Your health pool and a zero-cost Infected Bonesaw edge the level-1 trade — poke from max range, last-hit, and take only the short exchanges his single ability can answer.

edits.before: Q ranks make the cleaver chunk real HP and your passive regen ramps. Wukong must kill you through the sustain or watch you out-scale — most can't.
edits.after: His Nimbus Strike burst is at its sharpest here while your regen has not ramped yet. Give ground, farm with the cleaver, and let levels 4-5 pass without a fight.

edits.before: Maximum Dosage online — dives and all-ins flip when you press R mid-fight and regen half your HP. Force Wukong to commit, then out-last the commit.
edits.after: Cyclone is up and its knockup catches you mid-chase — Maximum Dosage regen keeps you alive through it, but the level still belongs to him. Never initiate here.

edits.before: Your windows: Level 6, First item, 2+ items. His windows: Level 1, Level 2. Fight at your spikes, concede his — the level chart above is the trade calendar.
edits.after: Your windows: Level 1, Level 3, First item, 2+ items. His: Level 2, Levels 4-5, Level 6. Fight at yours, concede his — the level chart above is the trade calendar.

edits.before: See the level-by-level chart — fight in your windows (Level 6, First item, 2+ items), respect his (Level 1, Level 2).
edits.after: See the level-by-level chart — fight in your windows (Levels 1, 3, First item, 2+), respect his (Level 2, 4-5, 6).

edits.before: Track Wukong’s Nimbus Strike (8s): His escape. Punish the cooldown. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Crushing Blow resets his auto — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast. Step back on the swing, not on a cooldown.

notes: This is a seesaw lane and the level chart was flattened into the generic 'his early, my late' shape. Four rows were wrong and the page's own whys[] text and the packet chart both already said so. Three phases[].why lines were rewritten because they directly contradicted the corrected side — phases[4] in particular claimed Level 6 flips to Dr. Mundo when Cyclone is the reason it does not.
unverified: Nimbus Strike's 8s cooldown, cited in breakdown.cooldowns and report[9]. The brief's enemyKit was null for Wukong, so no Riot cooldown data was available to confirm or correct it. That number was left untouched rather than guessed at; report[5].t was rewritten to lead with the auto-reset tell instead of leaning on the unverified figure.
Wukong's armour-shred (Stone Skin / Crushing Blow) is asserted in spikes[0], spikes[2] and report[11]. Not verifiable without the kit file; left as-is.
